scope: Structural validation and arithmetic preflight only; no scientific experiment outcomes

normalizations.preserved_text: Information test: chi-squared uniformity of the statistic over lifts and mutual information with k.
Canonical lift: root of the Hilbert class polynomial H_D mod p, Hensel-lifted to Z_p (this is the canonical lift for a CM curve); run the same attack.
Descent-direction control: the same code on Jac(C)/F_q with E/F_{q^g}, where the gain is expected.
Small p (<= 200, Phi_p available): compute the canonical lift j in Z_p by Newton on Phi_p(j, j^sigma); confirm H_D(j) = 0 mod p^k; record cost vs precision.
p in 2^20 .. 2^48, 200 random ordinary curves per size: compute D, h(D); fit; record the global degree [H:Q] the lift would need.
(c) targeted search: twist by (t - t_0) g(t), vary g to hit the target twist class, measure the rank change.
Oracle baseline: lattice enumeration over small v with known generators, i.e. a small-coefficient knapsack in E(F_p); records the cost when generators are known.
Planted instances: a random known section of height <= H through R.
Random-system control: dense system with identical variable count and degrees and one planted solution.
End-to-end known-answer prototype at toy p: r relations (sections through O) + one target, verify recovered logs.

D4_null_model.assumption: Approximately uniform map to a subgroup of this order; deterministic origin excluded

E4_illustration.interpretation: Volume heuristic only; does not refute a numerical claim about a different determinant
